zh: 折行宽度（单位=全角宽，不是字数：1 个汉字/假名/韩文音节=1；拉丁·西里尔·泰文·阿拉伯字母=0.5，即半角文字 1 单位≈2 字符）。作用于单语折行，以及双语的「- A - B」双说话人行。默认随目标语言按 Netflix 规范推荐（中/韩 16、日 13、其余 21）。调大 → 一行更长、行数和切分更少。
en: Single-language width in full-width UNITS, not characters: 1 CJK char = 1; Latin, Cyrillic, Thai and Arabic letters = 0.5, so 1 unit is about 2 characters for half-width scripts. Governs monolingual wrapping and "- A - B" dual-speaker lines in bilingual export. Default follows the Netflix spec per language (zh/ko 16, ja 13, others 21). Larger = longer lines, fewer line breaks and cue splits.

zh: 双语导出时【译文行】的宽度上限（同为全角宽单位，不是字数：同样 32，中文≈32 字，泰文≈64 字符）。只约束译文行，源文行跟随语义断点、不限宽；双说话人行走上方「单语行宽」。只有译文超出才拆时间轴。此值不随语言变化。调大 → 拆分更少但译文行更长。
en: Max width of the TRANSLATED line in bilingual export (same full-width unit, not characters: the same 32 is about 32 Chinese characters but about 64 Thai characters). Constrains the translated line only; the source line follows semantic breaks and is not width-limited, and dual-speaker lines use "Single-language width" above. Exceeding it is the only thing that splits the timeline. This value does NOT change per language. Larger = fewer splits but longer translated lines.

zh: 歌词行的处理方式：翻译／保留原文（不翻译）／删除（整组移除）。判断依据是「歌词标记」里的字符。

zh: 含这些字符的字幕行视为歌词。默认 ♪♫♬♩，可增删；留空自动恢复默认。若源文件歌词不带任何符号，可加入该字幕独有的标记。一行内歌词与对白混排时，删除档会自动降级为保留原文，不会误删对白。
en: Subtitle lines containing any of these characters are treated as lyrics. Default ♪♫♬♩ — add or remove freely; leave empty to restore the default. If your file uses no music symbols, add the marker it does use. When a line mixes lyrics with dialogue, “Remove” falls back to keeping the original so dialogue is never deleted.

zh: 选好目标语言丢进来，句级合并、术语统一、折行排版一次做完。译文严格贴合原时间轴，导出的时间轴一条都不漂。
en: Pick your target language and drop the file in: sentence merging, glossary consistency and line wrapping all happen in one pass. The translation stays locked to the original timing — not a single cue drifts.

zh: 从网站扒下来的字幕总带着广告、水印和听障提示。13 条规则按需开关，改了什么逐条列给你看，还能一条条撤回——时间轴一动不动。
en: Scraped subtitles come with ads, watermarks and hearing-impaired tags. Thirteen rules you can switch on and off, every change listed line by line and undoable one at a time — the timing never moves.

zh: 手上是一条单语字幕，还是已经排好的双语，都能在这里定型：字体、字号、颜色、描边、位置、边距逐项调，预览就是你导出拿到的那一份。
en: Whether you start from a single track or an already-paired bilingual one, this is where it gets its final look: font, size, colour, outline, position and margins, tuned one by one. The preview is exactly what you export.

zh: RiseKol 视频下载器：粘个链接就能把视频、音频和原文字幕存到本地。桌面客户端，macOS 与 Windows 都有。
en: RiseKol video downloader: paste a link and save the video, audio and original subtitles to your machine. A desktop app for macOS and Windows.

zh: 100 种语言互译，句级合并后按时长回填
en: Translate between 100 languages; merged sentences are re-timed by duration

zh: 自动提取专名生成术语表，全片译法一致
en: Proper nouns are collected into a glossary, so the whole file stays consistent

zh: 超长自动折行，按标点与词边界走，不劈词
en: Long lines wrap at punctuation and word edges — no words split in half

zh: 导出单语 / 双语，SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / TXT
en: Export mono or bilingual: SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / TXT

zh: 去水印广告、听障提示、HTML 标签与 ASS 特效标记
en: Strip watermarks, ads, SDH cues, HTML tags and ASS effect codes

zh: 全大写、乱码、多余空行一并修掉
en: Fix all-caps, mojibake and stray blank lines in the same pass

zh: 改动对照表逐条可还原，只改文本不动时间
en: Each change is listed and revertible; only text is touched

zh: 源文件是双语 ASS 时，合并与翻转也在这做
en: Source is a bilingual ASS? Merge and flip it here too

zh: 单语整饰 / 调整已有双语 / 两份合成双语，三种模式
en: Three modes: style a single track, adjust bilingual rows, or merge two files

zh: ASS 与 VTT 各一套模板，样式槽逐项微调
en: Templates for ASS and VTT each, with style slots for fine-tuning

zh: 字体、颜色、描边、位置、安全边距全部可视调节
en: Font, colour, outline, position and safe margins — all visual

zh: 时间轴就地精修：整体偏移、比例缩放、重叠体检
en: Retiming on the spot: global shift, proportional scale, overlap check

zh: 粘个链接就能下：视频、音频、字幕
en: Paste a link: video, audio and subtitles

zh: macOS 与 Windows 桌面客户端
en: Desktop app for macOS and Windows

zh: 客户端自己下载，不依赖浏览器插件
en: Downloads run in the app itself — no browser extension needed

zh: 一条对一条；需要合并拆分时按时长智能分配
en: One cue to one cue; merges and splits share their duration by length

zh: 逐条列出改了什么，可一条条还原
en: Every change is listed, and each one can be undone

zh: 预览 = 导出；样式槽改一项，整片跟着变
en: Preview = export; tweak a slot and the whole file follows

zh: 视频、音轨、字幕分轨下载
en: Video, audio and subtitles download as separate tracks

zh: 字幕翻译 - SRT / VTT / ASS 在线翻译成母语 | 随心字幕 AI
en: Subtitle Translator — Turn SRT / VTT / ASS into Your Language

zh: 因AI算力紧张，请你耐心等几分钟^^
en: AI capacity is tight right now — your results will be ready in a moment

zh: SRT / VTT / ASS 等 7 种格式互转
en: Convert between 7 formats: SRT / VTT / ASS and more

zh: 把双语字幕拆成原文轨和译文轨
en: Split bilingual subtitles into source and translation tracks

zh: 整体偏移、缩放、合并拆分、逐条微调
en: Global offset, rescale, merge, split, cue-by-cue tweak

zh: 认出认错的编码，把乱码倒回原样
en: Detect the misread encoding and undo the garble

zh: 从字幕里提取纯台词，两种排版
en: Pull plain dialogue out of subtitles, two layouts

zh: 字幕格式，随手一转就好
en: Convert subtitle formats in one step

zh: SRT、VTT、ASS、SBV、LRC——手里这份放不进播放器，转一下就好。时间轴和文本逐字保留，同轴双语转出来不会叠成两行。
en: SRT, VTT, ASS, SBV, LRC—if the file will not load in your player, just convert it. Timings and text are kept character for character, and same-timeline bilingual pairs never stack into two lines.

zh: 读 SRT / VTT / ASS / SSA / SBV / LRC / TXT，共 7 种
en: Reads SRT / VTT / ASS / SSA / SBV / LRC / TXT — 7 formats

zh: 导出 SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / LRC / TXT，共 6 种
en: Exports SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / LRC / TXT — 6 formats

zh: 时间轴与文本逐字保留，不重排不丢条
en: Timings and text preserved verbatim; nothing re-ordered or dropped

zh: 双语处理四档：保留 / 只留原文 / 只留译文 / 智能去重
en: Four bilingual modes: keep / source only / translation only / smart dedupe

zh: 双语字幕，拆成干净的两轨
en: Split bilingual subtitles into two clean tracks

zh: 一条字幕里挤着原文和译文，或者双语 ASS 转出来两条叠在一起——四种模式拆开：整份保留、只留原文、只留译文、拆成两份各带各的时间轴。
en: Source and translation crammed into one cue, or a bilingual ASS that converts into two stacked lines—four modes take it apart: keep both, source only, translation only, or split into two files with their own timelines.

zh: 一条里两行：按文字系统判断哪行是原文
en: Two lines in one cue: the source line is told by writing system

zh: 同轴两条：按出现先后分出原文轨与译文轨
en: Two cues on the same timeline: tracks are separated by order of appearance

zh: 不假设译文一定是中文：英日、英法照样拆
en: Never assumes the translation is Chinese—English-Japanese, English-French all work

zh: 只处理文本，时间轴一条不动
en: Text only is touched; the timeline stays untouched

zh: 时间轴不对？拉一下就好
字幕早半秒晚半秒、帧率对不上、想合并拆分、单条微调，都在一个页里做完。改完还是原来的格式，文件头一样不少。
en: Subtitles half a second early or late, frame-rate mismatch, merging and splitting, cue-by-cue fine-tuning—all in one page. The output keeps the original format, file header and all.

zh: 整体偏移：+1.5s、-500ms、纯数字毫秒都认
en: Global offset: accepts +1.5s, -500ms, or plain milliseconds

zh: 比例缩放：23.976 与 25 的帧率错位一键拉正
en: Rescale: fix 23.976 vs 25 frame-rate drift in one click

zh: 合并 / 拆分：相邻条目随手并，长句按词边界切
en: Merge / split: join neighboring cues freely; long lines split on word boundaries

zh: 时间轴体检：四把尺子扫一遍，只标建议不乱改
en: Timeline checkup: four rulers scan the file, flagging suggestions without touching anything

zh: 字幕乱码，认出它本来的样子
en: Garbled subtitles, restored to what they really are

zh: 打开是「æ—¥æœ¬èªž」这种天书？多半是编码认错了。认出它原本是 GBK 还是 Shift_JIS，把读错的字倒回去，另存成想要的编码。
en: Opened the file and got gibberish like "æ—¥æœ¬èªž"? The encoding was most likely misread. Detect whether it was GBK or Shift_JIS, undo the misreading, and save it in the encoding you want.

zh: 认得 UTF-8 / GBK / Big5 / Shift_JIS / EUC-KR / Latin-1
en: Recognizes UTF-8 / GBK / Big5 / Shift_JIS / EUC-KR / Latin-1

zh: 粘贴的文本也能试；替换符太多会直说修不回来
en: Pasted text works too; if too much is lost, it says so honestly

zh: 文件往往没坏——结果卡永远可用，默认另存 UTF-8
en: The file is usually fine—the result card is always there, saving UTF-8 by default

zh: 另存六档编码，认出错编码时默认带 BOM
en: Save as six encodings; a detected mismatch defaults to BOM

zh: 把台词从字幕里提出来
en: Pull the dialogue out of your subtitles

zh: 做笔记、发文章、喂模型，要的是纯文本不是时间码。连续段落像一篇文章，逐条一行像一份清单；听障提示、水印、重复句顺手去掉。
en: For notes, articles, or feeding a model, you want plain text, not timecodes. Continuous paragraphs read like an article; one line per cue reads like a list. Hearing-impaired captions, watermarks and repeated lines are dropped along the way.

zh: 读 SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / LRC / TXT
en: Reads SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / LRC / TXT

zh: 两种排版：按停顿句读拼成段落，或一行一条
en: Two layouts: paragraphs by pause and punctuation, or one line per cue

zh: 可选去听障提示、水印行、相邻重复句
en: Optionally remove SDH captions, watermark lines, and adjacent duplicates

zh: 说话人前缀与歌词行默认保留，可一键关掉
en: Speaker prefixes and lyric lines are kept by default, one click to drop

zh: 逗号变点、序号褪掉，内容一个字不差
en: Commas become dots, cue numbers fade—content untouched

zh: 拆完两份各自独立，时间轴原样带走
en: Two independent files, timelines carried over intact

zh: 整体偏移 0.5s：每一条一起挪，间隙不变
en: Global 0.5s shift: every cue moves together, gaps unchanged

zh: 认出它本来的编码，把读错的字倒回去
en: Detect the original encoding and undo the misreading

zh: 时间码褪掉，只剩台词本身
en: Timecodes fade away; only the dialogue remains

zh: 按术语表批量改词，逐条可还原
en: One glossary rewrites the whole file

zh: 整片字幕的用词，一次改统一
en: One wording, right through the whole file

zh: 人名地名前后不一致、专有名词各家叫法不同、机器翻译留下的错词 —— 写一份术语表，剩下的交给它。时间轴、ASS 样式、VTT 的 NOTE 块一个字符都不动。
en: Character names drifting between episodes, proper nouns spelled three ways, odd words left behind by machine translation — write a glossary and let it run. Timing, ASS styles and VTT note blocks stay byte-identical.

zh: 每行一条规则：原词 -> 新词，# 开头是注释
en: One rule per line: old term -> new term; # starts a comment

zh: 整词匹配、区分大小写，双语条目可只改一行
en: Whole-word matching, case sensitivity, bilingual cues can be limited to one line

zh: SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / LRC / TXT 都支持
en: Works with SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / LRC / TXT

zh: 改动逐条列出，哪一条不想改点一下就退回
en: Every change is listed; any line you regret goes back with one click

zh: 术语表一改，整片跟着改
en: Change the glossary, the whole file follows

zh: 把 MKV / MP4 里的内封字幕轨抽成 SRT
en: Pull the embedded subtitle track out of MKV / MP4

zh: 视频里封着的字幕轨，直接抽出来
en: The subtitle track sealed inside your video, pulled straight out

zh: MKV、MP4 里常常埋着一条现成的字幕轨，播放器能开，却拿不到文本。把它整条抽出来存成 SRT / VTT / ASS / TXT —— 不上传、不重编码，文件就在你自己的浏览器里读。
en: MKV and MP4 files often carry a finished subtitle track — your player can show it, but you cannot get at the text. Rip the whole track out to SRT / VTT / ASS / TXT. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is re-encoded: the file is read inside your own browser.

zh: 认 MKV / WebM 的 SRT、ASS、WebVTT 轨，也认 MP4 的 mov_text / tx3g
en: Reads SRT, ASS and WebVTT tracks in MKV / WebM, plus mov_text / tx3g in MP4

zh: ASS 轨连原文件的样式头和分辨率一起带回，不是重新生成一套
en: ASS tracks come back with the original style header and resolution, not a regenerated one

zh: 按文件位置小段读取，几个 G 的电影也不会把内存吃满
en: Reads in small slices by file offset, so a multi-gigabyte movie never fills up memory

zh: 图形字幕（DVD / 蓝光 PGS）没有文字可抽，会直说 —— 那需要 OCR
en: Image-based subtitles (DVD / Blu-ray PGS) have no text to rip, and it says so plainly — those need OCR

zh: 简繁互转，可选台湾 / 香港用法
en: Simplified ⇄ Traditional, Taiwan / Hong Kong aware

zh: 简繁互转，只改字不改别的
en: Between Simplified and Traditional — the words change, nothing else does

zh: 整份字幕在简体与繁体之间互转，九个方向：通用繁体、台湾用词、台湾字形、香港用法，以及繁体转回简体。时间码、序号和 ASS 样式标签一个字节都不动。
en: Convert a whole subtitle file across nine directions: general Traditional, Taiwan vocabulary, Taiwan forms, Hong Kong, and back to Simplified. Timecodes, cue numbers and ASS style tags stay byte-identical.

zh: 一简对多繁按词决定：同一个简体字该用哪个繁体，由前后的字决定
en: One Simplified character can map to several Traditional ones — the right one is picked by phrase

zh: 台湾档连用词一起换，不只是换字形
en: Taiwan mode swaps the vocabulary too, not just the shape of the character

zh: SRT / VTT / ASS / TXT 都支持，VTT 的 NOTE 与 STYLE 块不动
en: Works on SRT / VTT / ASS / TXT; VTT NOTE and STYLE blocks are left alone

zh: 词库取自 OpenCC，长词优先匹配
en: Dictionary from OpenCC, with longest-match-first phrase resolution
Only the words change — the timeline does not

zh: 按时长条数切开，多份合一
en: Cut by duration or count, join many into one

zh: 一份切多段，多段拼一份
en: Cut one file into parts, or many into one

zh: 长字幕按时长或条数切成几段，每段可以从零重新计时；散落的多份按顺序接成一集，或按时间戳交织合并。序号自动重排，台词一个字不改。
en: Cut a long subtitle into parts by duration or count, each starting from zero if you like; join scattered files into an episode in order, or interleave them by original timestamps. Renumbering is automatic; dialogue stays untouched.

zh: 只按字幕条边界切，绝不把一条台词从中间腰斩
en: Cuts only at cue boundaries — never mid-line

zh: 拼接保留每段内部的节奏，段间隔自己定
en: Joining keeps the rhythm inside each part; the gap is yours to set

zh: 交织模式按原始时间轴排序，重叠如实保留并提醒
en: Interleave mode sorts by original timeline and warns about overlaps

zh: SRT 与 VTT 都支持，拆完逐段下载
en: SRT and VTT both supported; download part by part

zh: Excel 里逐行校对，改完导回
en: Review line by line in Excel, import back

zh: 字幕搬进 Excel，改完再搬回来
en: Move subtitles into Excel, and back again

zh: 把 SRT / VTT 导出成 Excel 或 CSV，在表格里逐行校对、翻译、写批注，然后整表导回字幕。时间列按文本保真不丢毫秒，台词换行原样进单元格。
en: Export SRT / VTT to Excel or CSV, review, translate and annotate line by line in the sheet, then bring the whole table back as subtitles. Time columns stay text-exact; line breaks survive the round trip.

zh: 时间列保持 00:00:01,000 原样文本，毫秒不丢
en: Time columns keep 00:00:01,000 as-is — milliseconds intact

zh: 单元格里的换行导回字幕时原样还原
en: Line breaks inside cells are restored verbatim

zh: 中英文列头都认，识别不了的行自动跳过
en: Chinese and English headers both work; unparseable rows are skipped

zh: 表格发出去审稿，收回来直接导回字幕
en: Send the sheet out for review, import it back when it returns

zh: 几百个文件一次转，打包 ZIP
en: Convert hundreds of files into one ZIP

zh: 整个文件夹的字幕，一次换完格式
en: A whole folder of subtitles, one format change

zh: 几十上百个 SRT / VTT 拖进来，统一转成目标格式，打成一个 ZIP 拿走。序号重排、时间戳规范化，认不出的文件单独标出来不含糊。
en: Drag in dozens or hundreds of SRT / VTT files, convert them all to the target format and take away one ZIP. Renumbering and timestamp normalization included; unreadable files are flagged, not hidden.

zh: 文件名保持原名只换扩展名，重名自动加序号
en: Original filenames kept — only the extension changes; collisions get a suffix

zh: 全程在浏览器里完成，几百个文件也不上传
en: Everything runs in your browser; hundreds of files, zero uploads

zh: 认不出的文件单独列出、不进包，不静默丢弃
en: Unreadable files are listed and left out of the ZIP, never silently dropped

zh: 剧集整季目录拖进来，格式立刻统一
en: Drop a whole season folder in and unify the format

zh: 听歌逐句点时间，导出 LRC
en: Tap each line while listening, export LRC

zh: 边听边敲，一首歌的 LRC 就出来了
en: Listen and tap — an LRC takes shape

zh: 放入音乐、贴入歌词，播放的同时逐句敲下时间点，导出标准 LRC 或 SRT。已有的 LRC 也能导入微调。空格播放暂停、回车打轴、Z 撤销，双手不离键盘。
en: Load the music, paste the lyrics, and stamp each line while it plays; export standard LRC or SRT. Existing LRC files can be imported for fine-tuning. Space to play/pause, Enter to stamp, Z to undo — hands stay on the keyboard.

zh: 支持 MP3 / M4A / FLAC / WAV / OGG 常见音频
en: MP3 / M4A / FLAC / WAV / OGG supported

zh: 快捷键打轴，双手不离键盘
已有 LRC 导入微调，一句一句对
en: Import an existing LRC and adjust line by line

zh: 导出 LRC 给播放器，导出 SRT 给剪辑软件
en: LRC for players, SRT for editors

zh: 按这门语言的规矩查时间轴与排版
en: Check timing and layout by that language's rules

zh: 字幕交出去之前，过一遍体检
en: Run a check before you hand it over

zh: 上传字幕，选它是哪门语言，17 条规则逐条查：时间戳倒挂、序号断号、条目重叠、太快太慢、行太长、断行断错位置、全角半角标点，还有这门语言才有的规矩——西语的倒问号、法语的不换行空格、希腊语与阿拉伯语的问号。每处问题都附上实测值和门槛，能自动修的勾一下就修好。
en: Upload a subtitle, tell it which language it is, and 17 rules go through it one by one: reversed timestamps, gaps in the numbering, overlapping cues, too fast or too slow, lines too long, breaks in the wrong place, wrong punctuation — plus the rules only that language has: Spanish inverted question marks, French non-breaking spaces, Greek and Arabic question marks. Every finding carries the measured value next to the threshold, and whatever can be fixed is fixed with a checkbox.

zh: 17 条规则各自可开关，每处都标出实测值
en: 17 rules, each switchable, each showing the measured value

zh: 门槛跟着文字系统走，中文不按 42 个字符算
en: Thresholds follow the writing system: Chinese is not counted as 42 characters

zh: 语言专属的标点规矩，只在该有的语言上启用
en: Language-specific punctuation rules only switch on where they exist

zh: 能自动修的单独列出，会动时间轴的默认不勾
en: Auto-fixable items are listed apart; anything moving the timeline starts unchecked
